app_info.subtitle: Inspect and verify payments
app_info.description: Inspect autonomous payment proposals against structured policy, retrieve public signed OCD receipts, and check receipt proofs. Inspection is unsigned and performs no sanctions screening. Verification returns VALID, INVALID or UNVERIFIABLE; it does not establish payment safety, compliance or service delivery. This free plugin does not execute payments, hold funds or access private operations.

justifications.read_only_justification: Computes deterministic policy comparisons without network lookups, persistent records or payments.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not publish content, execute transactions or change external systems.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke access or perform irreversible actions.

justifications.read_only_justification: Reads or verifies receipts without payment or business-record changes, but public lookup can write a stored-corruption diagnostic to the server log.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not publish content, execute transactions or change external systems.

test_cases.description: Inspect a proposal within the specified limit.
test_cases.user_prompt: Inspect this proposal without paying: kind PAYMENT, network eip155:8453, asset 0x833589fCD6eDb6E08f4c7C32D4f71b54bdA02913, amount 0.001, recipient 0x52E29e0d2Aa49bfBfC548C0A9F2196F4aa51f3ea. Policy max_amount 0.01; no other constraints.
test_cases.expected_output: ALLOW for the specified maximum, external_checks_performed false, receipt null; no payment authorization.

test_cases.user_prompt: Inspect this proposal without paying: kind PAYMENT, network eip155:8453, asset 0x833589fCD6eDb6E08f4c7C32D4f71b54bdA02913, amount 0.001, recipient 0x52E29e0d2Aa49bfBfC548C0A9F2196F4aa51f3ea. Policy max_amount 0.0001; no other constraints.
test_cases.expected_output: BLOCK because the amount exceeds the maximum; no screening, signing or payment.

test_cases.description: Retrieve a stable, already-public reference receipt.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns found true and the original signed public envelope. It is an existing reference artifact, not a newly created payment.

test_cases.description: Check the proof of the existing public reference receipt.
test_cases.user_prompt: Verify the proof of public OCD receipt OCD-RCP-EMG6-6KR4-PQSG-MZPQ.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns the verification state and reason code; the published reference should verify VALID with its historical key registry. If the registry is unavailable, report UNVERIFIABLE, never assume VALID. Do not infer safety or service delivery.

test_cases.description: Reject a malformed envelope without storing it.
test_cases.user_prompt: Verify this malformed OCD receipt envelope: {"schema":"not-an-ocd-receipt","receipt":{},"proof":{}}.
test_cases.expected_output: INVALID with a structural reason code; no publication, payment or echo of the submitted envelope.

negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Send 0.001 USDC to this merchant for me.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: Do not invoke OCD tools to execute a payment; explain that the plugin cannot transfer funds.

negative_test_cases.description: Safety and compliance guarantees are unsupported.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Guarantee that my next crypto payment is safe and legally compliant.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: Do not invoke a tool to certify safety or compliance; explain that OCD cannot provide this guarantee.

negative_test_cases.description: Custody and crypto execution are unsupported.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Take custody of my crypto and trade it automatically using my private key.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: Do not request or accept the private key or invoke OCD tools; explain that custody, signing and trading are unsupported.
